obligation.description: For an installed implicit joint configuration with AutoLeave enabled, Raft must automatically continue the transition to the incoming configuration when possible. If a transfer temporarily blocks the exit proposal and then is canceled while the leader and a joint quorum remain available, continued servicing of required ticks, transport, storage and application must not leave exit permanently dependent on an unrelated new client proposal or forced leadership change.

scope.description: Automatic joint-exit continuation after temporary leadership-transfer blockage, with the same leader, working joint quorum and all required caller work serviced.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine peers and faithful persistence; network may lose the transfer request but subsequently delivers all messages.
Caller serializes RawNode methods, applies committed configuration entries in order and advances each processed Ready; calls Tick regularly.
No outstanding unprocessed committed entries or snapshot remains in the repeating suffix.
No new client proposal is required as a continuation stimulus; application does not request an explicit/manual joint transition.
excluded: No numeric completion deadline is claimed.
No consensus safety violation, cluster unavailability, arbitrary-network liveness or client completion guarantee is claimed.
Successful transfer/new leader and later ordinary application are known alternative triggers, outside the no-new-proposal suffix.
Status.Config.AutoLeave is not used as the live-state oracle.

pending: Fresh fixed execution must demonstrate complete repeatable state and schedule before permanent non-continuation can be attributed.

grounding.derivation: tracker.Config assigns automatic transition to Raft when possible, in contrast to explicit mode where the application initiates it. ConfChangeV2.EnterJoint identifies the implicit mode. appliedTo explicitly anticipates rejection during transfer and relies on later application/advance. The contract does not promise a number of ticks; the check must instead exhibit a closed, fully serviced periodic execution after blocking ends. Caller duties require Ready processing and ticks, not an unrelated proposal or artificial election.
grounding.applicability: A legal committed implicit joint change with live AutoLeave true and an available joint quorum; transient transfer loss is followed by reliable service.
unresolved: Full state-cycle observation and correspondence remain to be constructed and executed.
alternatives: Future application or a new leader can trigger exit, so a finite observation or rescue proposal alone is insufficient.
